title: feat(spec,lint): resolve action → flow and widget → dataset references against the release artifact
body:
Fixes #25514

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Ruling-ref: 6377677280

## What

One release artifact carries several packages (ADR-0130 D4). Two per-package checks judged a reference against one package, so they refused a target that a sibling package of the same artifact provides:

1. **`packages/spec`, defect 1.** `validateCrossReferences` built its flow scope from the stack's own `flows` alone. A `type: 'flow'` action whose `target` names a sibling package's flow was refused with "which is not defined in flows." This applied in all three positions: top-level `actions[]`, `objects[].actions[]`, and inline page actions.
2. **`packages/lint`, defect 2.** `widget-dataset-unknown` (`validateWidgetBindings`) built its `datasets` map from `stack.datasets` alone. It ignored the `packages[]` resolution context that the CLI's per-package pass already supplies.

Following ruling 6377677280 (option A), both reference classes now resolve against the **artifact**. A flow or dataset that **no** package of the artifact defines stays refused, exactly as before. Scope is same-artifact only. Cross-artifact resolution is #25403's ADR and is not touched here.

## Contract (public-surface widening)

- **New `DefineStackOptions.artifactFlows?: readonly string[]`** (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`). It lists the flow names the other packages of the artifact provide. A flow action's target resolves against own `flows` ∪ these names. It mirrors `artifactObjects`.
  - It **widens** a check that already runs and never switches one on. A stack with no flows of its own keeps the plugin leniency (`flowNames.size === 0`), unchanged.
  - **Declared means enforced.** Every target that resolved *only* through the list is recorded on the stack `defineStack` returns. The record is a non-enumerable `Symbol.for('objectstack.stack.artifact-flow-claims')` property beside the provenance mark, so it is not a schema key and not in `dist/objectstack.json`. `composeStacks` step 3b (`collectArtifactFlowClaimErrors`) refuses the composition when no input defines a recorded target. The refusal uses the same `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID`/422 envelope and the byte-identical per-finding message. A flow is "defined by an input" when it is in that input's top-level `flows` or, for a nested multi-package artifact, in a `packages[].manifest.flows` body.
  - **Why a record and not the `artifactObjects` re-run.** Re-running the flow rule over every input at composition would also newly refuse a dangling target in an input built with `strict: false`. That is a narrowing this card does not declare. The record checks exactly the promise the option made. An input that did not opt in cannot newly fail at composition, strict or not. That case is pinned.
  - Boundary, the same as `artifactObjects`: a one-package composition, or a stack that is never composed, leaves the claim unverified.
- **`widget-dataset-unknown`** reads `packagesOf(stack)` (the existing `packages/lint` reader) and adds each body's `datasets` to the map, the way `validate-object-references.ts` widens rung ① with `artifactProvidedObjectNames`. This is resolution context only. Dataset-level checks (`measure-aggregate-incoherent`) still walk `stack.datasets` alone, and the stack's own declaration wins a shared name. **`packages/cli` is untouched**: `packageBodyAsStack` already passes `packages[]`.
- **Runtime publish gate (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts`): neither widened nor broken.** Its judged stack never carries `packages` (no `packages` key in `runtime-gate.ts` / `runtime-authoring-gate.ts`), so `packagesOf` answers `[]` and the rule behaves exactly as before. Its tests are green (below).

## Booted measurement (ruling note 2)

I boot-tested a temporary (uncommitted) extension of `examples/app-multi-package`:
- **`orders`** (`type: module`) ships the flow `crm_order_stamp` (start → `create_record` on `crm_order` → end) and the dataset `crm_order_metrics`.
- **`core`** (`type: app`) has its own flow `crm_core_noop`, so the flow check runs at all. It has `crm_account.actions[stamp_orders] → type 'flow', target 'crm_order_stamp'`, a dashboard widget `order_totals` bound to `crm_order_metrics`, and `defineStack(..., { artifactFlows: ['crm_order_stamp'] })`. Its `requires` is `['automation']`.

```text
$ PROBE_NO_CLAIM=1 objectstack validate        # option omitted: today's behaviour
  ✗ Action 'stamp_orders' on object 'crm_account' references flow 'crm_order_stamp' which is not defined in flows.
exit 1
$ objectstack validate                          # with artifactFlows
  → Running author-time rules per package (2)...
  ✓ Validation passed                           exit 0
$ objectstack build  → dist/objectstack.json packages[]:
  com.example.multi.orders {"flows":["crm_order_stamp"],"datasets":["crm_order_metrics"],"dashboards":[],"actions":[]}
  com.example.multi.core   {"flows":["crm_core_noop"],"datasets":[],"dashboards":["crm_overview→crm_order_metrics"],"actions":["crm_account.stamp_orders→crm_order_stamp"]}
$ objectstack dev --fresh -p 38517              # AutomationServicePlugin + AnalyticsServicePlugin up
GET  /api/v1/data/crm_order                     → {"records":[],"total":0}
POST /api/v1/actions/crm_account/stamp_orders/W79i9VpR-IiyJjlz
  → HTTP 200 {"success":true,"data":{"success":true,"flowLabel":"Stamp Order","summary":{"acted":1,"nodes":[{"nodeId":"start","status":"success"},{"nodeId":"create_probe_order","nodeType":"create_record","status":"success","acted":1}]}}}
GET  /api/v1/data/crm_order                     → 1 record: {"name":"flow-started-from-core-action","amount":42}
GET  /api/v1/meta/dashboard/crm_overview        → widget {"id":"order_totals","dataset":"crm_order_metrics"}, packageId com.example.multi.core
POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query {"datasetName":"crm_order_metrics","selection":{"measures":["order_count","order_amount"],"dimensions":["name"]}}
  → HTTP 200 {"rows":[{"name":"flow-started-from-core-action","order_count":1,"order_amount":42},{"name":"manual-order","order_count":1,"order_amount":8}],"object":"crm_order", "sql":"SELECT name AS \"name\", COUNT(*) …, SUM(amount) … FROM \"crm_order\" GROUP BY name"}
```

So the app package's action starts the module package's flow, and the app package's widget's dataset (owned by the module) returns its rows. The server was stopped by its recorded PID, and the probe edits were restored (`git status` clean).

## Tests

- New `packages/spec/src/stack-artifact-flow-crossref.test.ts` (9): both directions per class across all three positions. A sibling flow is accepted at `defineStack` and at `composeStacks`. An unlisted flow is refused at `defineStack`. A claimed flow that no input defines is refused at `composeStacks` with the per-stack message, envelope and header. A nested multi-package input resolves. Fences: no own flows means no check, a non-opted `strict: false` input cannot newly fail, and no new enumerable key is added.
- New `packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.artifact-datasets.test.ts` (6): a sibling dataset is accepted, a dataset no package declares is refused, the single-package answer is unchanged, a resolved sibling dataset's measures are judged, a sibling's dataset-level findings are not judged on this package's pass, and the rule table reaches the per-package pass.
- **Ablations** (fix committed first; restored by `ablation-replace.mjs`, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - spec `artifactFlows?.has(target)` → never matches: **5/9 red**.
  - spec `...collectArtifactFlowClaimErrors(stacks),` deleted: **1/9 red** (the compose-time refusal).
  - lint packages loop reads a non-key, then rebuilt (`ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in 4 dist files): **3/6 red**. The real door `objectstack validate` on the probe exits **1** with HotCRM's exact defect-2 line, `package 'com.example.multi.core' — dashboard "crm_overview" › widget "order_totals": dataset "crm_order_metrics" does not resolve to a declared dataset.` (rule `widget-dataset-unknown`). After the restore and rebuild (marker absent from all 20 dist files), the door exits 0 and 6/6 pass.
- Package suites at `5cf84d58` (pre-merge): spec `pnpm test` 715 files / 21696 passed, `pnpm typecheck` 0; lint `pnpm test` 159 files / 7243 passed, `pnpm typecheck` 0. The CLI unit tier (`vitest run --project unit`) ran 327/327 files: 325 on the first run, plus `published-subpath-console` / `published-subpath-hook-body`, which needed `packages/cli` itself built and then passed, 29/29. metadata-protocol `protocol.dashboard-dataset-publish-gate`, `protocol.runtime-gate-stored-universe` and `protocol-publish-drafts-closure` ran 3 files / 24 passed. The CLI integration tier is left to CI; the diff touches no integration-tier file.
- After merging `origin/main` (`e649c2d91e`, the Version Packages commit) at head `45b786764e`: spec build plus `check:generated` show all 14 generated artifacts up to date. Spec flow and artifact cross-ref tests: 39 passed. Lint build plus both widget-binding test files: 184 passed.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 113 commands, with an identical derivation on `45b786764e`. All 113 exit 0. Four first returned PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3) or hit my own runner timeout, and passed once the prerequisite was met:
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: shallow clone, fixed with `git fetch --unshallow`.
- `spec check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: unbuilt sibling `dist/`, fixed by building those packages.
- `check:type-check-debt`: my 420 s cap; rerun uncapped, it exits 0.

`--ran` reconciliation: 113 derived, 113 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: every line carries its exit code). Re-run on `45b786764e`: the `--base origin/main` changeset gates, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:issue-citations` and spec `check:api-surface` all exit 0. Local-only families also exit 0: `check:dev-prereqs` and `check:skill-frame-freshness`. Dogfood battery: n/a (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).

## Acceptance notes

- The card's HotCRM acceptance rows (hotcrm#2270's patch validating unchanged, and `top_products` returning 4 rows) need a **released** `@objectstack/*` carrying this. They are measured downstream, not here. HotCRM must add `artifactFlows` to its app package's `defineStack` call. The dataset half needs no HotCRM change.
- The release is in progress: this PR stays **draft**. It is not to be readied, queued or merged until the maintainer lifts that.
- `content/docs/getting-started/examples.mdx` gains one bullet beside the existing `artifactObjects` paragraph.
